definitions.explanation: Thick, stiff paper used for crafts, packaging, backing for documents, and similar purposes. Thicker than regular paper but not as heavy as corrugated cardboard.

examples.japanese: {厚紙|あつがみ}で{箱|はこ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: I make a box out of cardboard.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{送|おく}るときは{厚紙|あつがみ}で{挟|はさ}んでください。
examples.english: When mailing photos, please sandwich them between pieces of cardboard.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{厚紙|あつがみ}とハサミを{使|つか}って{工作|こうさく}をしている。
examples.english: The children are doing crafts with cardboard and scissors.

notes:
Compound of {厚|あつ}い (thick) + {紙|かみ} (paper). Refers to stiff paper stock, not corrugated cardboard (which is {段|だん}ボール).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚紙|あつがみ}で{作|つく}る — to make from cardboard
- {厚紙|あつがみ}を{切|き}る — to cut cardboard
- {厚紙|あつがみ}に{印刷|いんさつ}する — to print on cardstock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {段|だん}ボール — corrugated cardboard (heavier, used for shipping boxes)
- {画用紙|がようし} — drawing paper (thick but for art use)
- {薄紙|うすがみ} — thin paper, tissue paper (opposite in thickness)
